# Persona Guidance

Use this compact working reference to choose a credible user context. The canonical source is https://ux.netapp.com/personas/comparison.html. Review it when the local summary is insufficient or needs updating.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-20.

| Persona | Primary context | Goals and useful writing signals |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Prashant, DevOps Engineer | Deploys and maintains cloud applications | Values automation, efficiency, reliability, uptime, and clear instructions; encounters integration and performance challenges. |
| Sal, Senior Storage Engineer | Leads storage infrastructure management | Designs resilient, efficient, scalable storage; values complex problem-solving, modernization, and operational leadership. |
| Zoe, Storage Administrator | Manages storage services | Optimizes storage reliability and performance; values efficient workflows, learning, and approachable tools. |
| Noah, Data Engineer | Builds and supports data pipelines and management services | Needs reliable, secure, well-governed data; values quality, accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement. |
| Samuel, Security Operations | Protects data and infrastructure | Prioritizes prevention, monitoring, rapid response, and compliance; is frustrated by slow fixes and security complexity. |
| Dana, Application/Database Owner | Manages business-critical applications | Needs application reliability, performance, compliance, and better user experiences; is concerned about downtime. |
| Delia, Automation Engineer | Automates storage and application processes | Seeks reliable, standardized automation and operational efficiency; encounters integration, tooling, and version-control challenges. |
| Kyle, Kubernetes Administrator | Manages cloud-native architectures | Needs scalable, efficient Kubernetes operations; values automation and technical proficiency; encounters resource and integration constraints. |
| Veronica, Virtualization Infrastructure Admin | Manages virtualized environments | Prioritizes availability, backup and recovery, and risk reduction through automation; faces workload-movement and integration risks. |
| Eva, Data Scientist | Develops AI and machine learning models | Needs data quality, integration, and sufficient compute capacity; focuses on insight and innovation. |
| Liam, AI Application Developer | Builds AI-enabled applications | Needs high-quality applications, AI-model integration, and performance; encounters data-quality and integration challenges. |
| Nancy, NetApp Software Developer | Develops and supports customer-facing data management services | Values customer experience, quality, reliability, and continuous improvement; handles complex requirements and rapid change. |
| Malia, FinOps Practitioner | Connects finance, engineering, and operations | Seeks accountable, data-backed cost decisions and contract value; faces inconsistent tagging, siloed accountability, and budget surprises. |

Use accessibility considerations from the canonical source only when they are relevant to the example. Do not infer a disability, role responsibility, or tool preference beyond the source material.
